### Strength and Dignity - Today's Insight - March 7, 2024
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-march-7-2024.html
Passage: Esther 2:9-10
Points:
- Esther responded to an unwanted and difficult circumstance with poise and grace rather than bitterness.
- Her inner godliness and charm captured Hegai's attention and set her apart from the other women.
- She practiced remarkable verbal restraint and loyalty by keeping her heritage hidden as Mordecai directed.
- Guarding confidences and maintaining self-control in speech are essential qualities of strength and dignity.
